% A file of the document beside it, nomencl.ltx, named like nomencl.4ht,
% that names itself \ProvidesFile{nomencl.ltx}, read with the primitive
% \input from a package of the document beside it, test-ownprim-beside.sty.
% As in the PDF, the file's text is in the page. nomencl.4ht's html4.4ht
% part defines \onthenomenclature:list, which the PDF does not have, so
% the page shows that it was read: a sentence the PDF does not have.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{test-ownprim-beside}
\begin{document}
Nomencl: \ownprimnomencl
\expandafter\ifx\csname onthenomenclature:list\endcsname\relax\else\par Nomencl read for the web.\fi
\end{document}
